issues.description: SR4 (false-positive rate) is never exercised by a failing mutant; validation shows SR4 dead_check and uncovered_requirement. No mutant that mislabels legitimate datapath nodes as suspect/counter/comparator/payload was tested to confirm SR4 actually fails on false positives.
issues.evidence: mutation_score report: SR4 dead_check, uncovered_requirement; per_requirement_coverage.SR4 mutants_detected=0, mutants_targeting=1

issues.description: FR3 and FR4 are untested by any mutant in the harness, leaving their correctness unverified via differential mutation testing even though they are structurally checked.

recommendations: Add a mutant/naive submission variant that mislabels or flags legitimate datapath nodes (e.g., acc_reg, sum_bit, carry, in, out) as suspect/counter/comparator/payload to exercise and confirm SR4 fails appropriately.
Add mutants that specifically break FR3 (invented node names) and FR4 (short summary) in isolation to raise their mutation coverage above zero.
Consider lowering fpr_threshold or ensuring at least one adversarial submission in the test suite triggers an SR4 FAIL to demonstrate discrimination.
